lines.directed: The duration associated with the unmanifest is multiplied by ten parārdhas to establish a day of Māyā.
Then the duration associated with Māyā is multiplied by one hundred parārdhas to arrive at a day in the realm of Īśvara.
The same period constitutes its night.
And in that night the creative movement of prāṇa subsides.
But here's a very subtle point.
Even at the level of Īśvara, succession has not been entirely transcended.
The prāṇa may be at rest in the region of the brahmabila.
